description: This file defines a Formatter package for handling colored output formatting, including color modes, style application, and text wrapping functionalities.

classes.name: Formatter
classes.description: A struct for managing text styling and color output, supporting different color modes and style application.

methods.name: F
methods.description: Formats a string with optional arguments, defaulting to no indentation.

methods.name: Fi
methods.description: Formats a string with specified indentation.

methods.name: Fiw
methods.description: Formats a string with specified indentation and maximum width, wrapping text accordingly.

methods.name: NewWithNoColorBool
methods.description: Creates a Formatter instance with or without color support based on a boolean flag.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Formatter with a specified color mode, configuring color aliases and environment-based settings.

methods.name: style
methods.description: Applies style to a string based on the current color mode, replacing style tags with ANSI codes or removing them.
